newsitem.title: USA: Dominion Resources sees charges in Q4 and 97.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Resources sees charges in Q4 and 97.

text.p: Dominion Resources Inc said on Friday that most of the restructuring charges related to Virginia Power will likely be taken in this year's fourth quarter, although some may be incurred in 1997.

The restructuring is part of the utility's ongoing efforts to streamline its operations and reduce its costs as part of a plan to prepare for an increasingly competitive electric industry in the United States, it said.
Dominion Resources also said its third quarter earnings dropped largely because of mild summer temperatures and destructive storms.

Virginia Power suffered heavy damage this year from severe summer storms, particularly Hurricane Fran, it said. Severe storm damages increased expenses by about $15 million, or $0.05 per share, from the same period last year.
In this year's third quarter, Dominion Resources reported net income of $162.2 million, or $0.91 per share, compared with $197.9 million, or $1.14 per share, during the same period the prior year.
